messages:
jess-support: FYI opening incident for AppFabrik — they report repeated 502/504 + timeouts since ~10:12 UTC. Ticket SF-3421. Sample reqs: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e. ~30% failures on /v1/generate. Escalating to infra. @sarah @tim-eng

deploy-bot: deploy completed to hosted-prod at 10:05 UTC (deploy id d-2026-03-17-1020).

tim-eng: Observable spike on gateway in eu-west-1 starting 10:11. 502 upstream reset / 504 deadline exceeded. p95 token timeouts up, batcher backlog rising. Pulling inference pool and KV-cache metrics now.

leo-oncall: Repro plan: I'll run a replay using the client's headers/ids. Curl snippet: 
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'X-Client-ID: appfabrik' -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

oliver: Can we route AppFabrik to a warm dedicated slot or fallback to a quantized/smaller variant temporarily? If it's capacity/batching, a smaller model should reduce per-token time.

sarah: Doing temporary routing now — bumping their concurrency and enabling short-circuit fallback to `gpt-small-quant` for 30m. Also setting circuit-breaker alarm to 10% error. Will report once done.

jess-support: Customer accepted the workaround. They asked for ETA on permanent fix and a short incident summary.

tim-eng: Correlation so far: KV-cache miss rate and prefix sharing jumped, causing batcher backlog and subsequent timeouts. Notable change: kernel-selector tweak in deploy d-2026-03-17-1020 seems to alter batching for long-seq models. Hypothesis: deploy changed kernel selection that increased latency under certain seq/batch combos.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for d-2026-03-17-1020 -> started 10:45 UTC.

maria-cs: Impact: AppFabrik (~enterprise) 15k requests last hour, ~30% error rate. They've escalated to enterprise support and want a public-facing summary + ETA.

leo-oncall: Repro completed — 504 achieved locally by simulating KV-cache churn + high prefix reuse. Logs snippet: 
```text
[10:12:34] batcher: backlog=128 queued=96 kv_miss=0.78
[10:12:35] runtime: kernel-selector: model=llama2-large quant=false path=opt-2
[10:12:36] runtime: upstream reset
```

tim-eng: Action items (short):
1) revert kernel-selector change -> @oliver (PR in progress)
2) add e2e test for KV-cache churn/backpressure -> @tim-eng
3) add per-customer KV miss rate metric + dashboard -> @sarah
4) customer-facing RCA draft and comms -> @maria-cs
I'll create tickets and link here.

oliver: Started revert PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5543

jess-support: Customer confirms errors dropped after temporary routing + rollback start. They'll keep us posted if anything else.

tim-eng: Current status: p95 latency and error rates trending down. Scheduling a postmortem for tomorrow 15:00 UTC to finalize RCA and long-term mitigations. Will attach timeline/logs.

maria-cs: I'll prepare the customer summary and coordinate the update once RCA is ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
